description: This file defines the SettingsManager class responsible for managing application settings, including loading from XML files, saving settings, and handling configuration paths. It interacts with other components like DOMSettingsUnmarshaller and DOMSettingsBuilder to parse and generate XML configurations.

classes.name: SettingsManager
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for loading, saving, and managing application settings, with file I/O and XML parsing capabilities.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Returns the current Settings object, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads settings from an XML file, attempting first from the user directory, then from the start directory, with fallback to default if reading fails.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the specified Settings object to an XML file, using default progress display.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the specified Settings object to an XML file with a provided progress indicator.
